name: MonarchLabeledContentStyle
title: DescriptionList
summary: The Monarch look for the standard LabeledContent: a muted label and a value, stacked or on one row. A column or Grid of them is a description list of a record's facts.
whenToUse: For the read-only facts of one record on a detail screen: owner, stage, created date, IDs.
whenNotToUse: For comparing many records, use a List or Table. For editable fields, use a Form with MonarchTextField or MonarchInlineEditText. Inside a Form or List the system LabeledContent style already fits.
api: static func monarch(_ layout: MonarchLabeledContentLayout) -> MonarchLabeledContentStyle  // LabeledContentStyle

options.name: layout
options.description: stacked puts the label above the value; inline puts them on one row and stacks them when they do not fit.

states.name: stacked
states.description: The label on its own line above the value.

states.name: inline
states.description: The label at the leading edge and the value at the trailing edge; stacked when the row does not fit.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Set with disabled(_:). Label and value use the disabled text colour.

appearance: The label uses the caption type role in the muted text colour and the value the body type role in the default text colour; both use the disabled text colour when disabled. There is no fill or border, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web DescriptionList has items with built-in copyable, truncate, wide and empty placeholder options, and a columns grid. On iOS the item is the standard LabeledContent, so those are composed: a copyable value puts MonarchCopyButton in the value, a long value uses MonarchTruncatedText, columns use Grid or LazyVGrid, and an empty value is text the app supplies (such as an em dash with the label "Not set"); Monarch has no built-in "Not set" string here. Android ships a MonarchDescriptionList type.
accessibility: Each LabeledContent is one element, read as the label and then the value.
A button in the value, such as a copy button, is kept as the action of the combined element.
Both texts scale with Dynamic Type; the inline layout stacks when the row does not fit.
edgeCases: A long value wraps under its label; in the inline layout it makes the item stack.
The style colours and sizes text; a value view that sets its own type role or colour keeps it.
How VoiceOver presents a copy button inside the combined element was not checked on a device.
